E0.scope: deterministic first-error repair and source-bound offline orchestration

confounds: fixed upstream route/review in captured inputs
native live tools, guards and persistence not evaluated
D0/D1/D2 prompt and evidence differ; not a single-factor full-Agent comparison
equal caps do not mean equal input tokens

holdout.policy: independent author and sealed input required; never relabel public items

review_policy: exact answer quote, mathematical basis, reviewer/date, input/response/rubric hashes; distinguish unreviewed and N/A; no aggregate score from fixtures
severe_failures: stale/private opinion presented as verified fact
analysis: all planned rows retained; descriptive paired deltas with raw evidence and R64 uncertainty contract; no significance or generalization claim from public small samples
